tt_silence_cut_pct: Cuts the longest pauses first until this share of the total pause time is removed. 100 = every detected pause. Lower it for slow speakers to keep their rhythm.
tt_silence_min_clip: Never leaves a piece shorter than this between two silence cuts: of two close pauses, only the longer one is cut. Avoids jumpy micro-cuts. 0 = off.
tt_silence_keep: Leaves this much of every cut pause in place so speech doesn't sound rushed. 0 = cut the whole pause.

你好！

为了帮助我改进 BadWords，你是否同意在安装/更新后发送一次 100% 匿名的统计 ping？

仅发送应用版本和操作系统类型（如 Windows）。绝不会收集音频文件、剧本或个人数据。

地理位置（国家/城市）为可选项——取消勾选下方选项即可关闭。

tt_more_accurate:
此选项允许你在转录前先粘贴/导入剧本。
将从剧本中提取关键词喂给 Whisper（音频转录模型），
从而提高转录准确度。

强烈建议包含大量非拼读词汇（如系统路径、带数字的名称、
特殊字符等）的技术性剧本使用此选项。

此外，此选项会自动运行“转录-剧本对照”算法，
转录完成后颜色立即可见，并排对照视图也能即刻加载。

tt_source_info_free:
Choose media source: you can edit an audio/video file directly from your disk, or use BadWords as a plugin for DaVinci Resolve (which enables applying cuts directly onto the timeline and color-coding clips).

DaVinci Resolve Connection:
Open DaVinci Resolve and run Workspace → Scripts → BadWords Bridge. You can also launch BadWords directly from inside DaVinci Resolve (via Workspace → Scripts → BadWords), but this option is only available for DaVinci Resolve versions older than 21.1.
tt_source_info_studio:
Choose media source: you can edit an audio/video file directly from your disk, or use BadWords as a plugin for DaVinci Resolve (which enables applying cuts directly onto the timeline and color-coding clips).

DaVinci Resolve Studio Connection:
You can launch BadWords directly or from inside DaVinci Resolve (via Workspace → Scripts → BadWords). Ensure that in DaVinci Resolve Preferences → System → General → External scripting using is set to Local.
tt_source_info_not_installed:
Choose media source: you can edit an audio/video file directly from your disk, or use BadWords as a plugin for DaVinci Resolve (which enables applying cuts directly onto the timeline and color-coding clips).

DaVinci Resolve:
Professional video editing software. Not detected on this system – downloading DaVinci Resolve is recommended for full timeline integration.
